world.title: 'No intention of keeping promises': Biden's explosive revelations about Netanyahu's Gaza war
world.summary: Joe Biden expressed strong support for Israel during its military campaign in Gaza following the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack. However, internal discussions revealed growing frustration with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Biden's remarks suggested a diminishing expectation for Netanyahu to uphold commitments, indicating a potential shift in the U.S. approach to Israel amid ongoing conflict in the region.

world.title: Israel coalition talks put Arab party leader under pressure over Hamas
world.summary: Mansour Abbas, leader of Israel's United Arab List (Ra’am), is under pressure from the change bloc to denounce Hamas as a terrorist organization. This stance is seen as a prerequisite for his party's involvement in the upcoming coalition government. The outcome of this pressure may significantly influence the political landscape in Israel moving forward.

world.title: An 85-year-old Massachusetts man allegedly sent more than $1 million to a woman he was dating for taxes on farmland she said she would inherit in Brazil; prosecutors say the land and inheritance never
world.summary: An 85-year-old Massachusetts man reportedly sent over $1 million to a woman he was dating, believing it was for taxes on farmland she claimed she would inherit in Brazil. Prosecutors allege that the land and inheritance were fictitious. The man, who has health and memory issues, was misled into providing substantial financial support to the woman.

business.title: Stock Markets This Week: WPI Inflation, Crude Oil, FII Trading Activity To Guide Movement, Say Analysts
business.summary: Indian stock markets are anticipated to experience cautious trading this week, influenced by wholesale price inflation, foreign institutional investor flows, and crude oil prices. Analysts suggest that these factors, along with global economic signals and geopolitical developments, will guide market sentiment. Investors are expected to closely monitor domestic inflation data amid a busy schedule of domestic and international events.

business.title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left company in August 2025
business.summary: Megaspeed confirmed on November 15, 2026, that Alice Huang officially left the company on August 30, 2025. The company emphasized its legitimate business operations and announced an internal investigation, which involves external legal counsel. Huang's previous connections to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang have raised concerns regarding U.S. national security, prompting scrutiny of her association with Megaspeed.

business.title: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Facebook's Android Gallery Access Without Explicit Consent
business.summary: Italy's data protection authority fined Meta €805 million for accessing users' Android gallery without explicit consent through a Facebook feature that suggests photos and videos for posting. The Garante ordered Meta to implement changes within 60 days to comply with data protection regulations. This ruling highlights ongoing concerns regarding user privacy and consent in digital platforms.

technology.title: Galaxy S27 dummies, Xiaomi 18s land in the office, Week 46 in review
technology.summary: Samsung's Galaxy S27 series has been leaked, showcasing dummy units of the S27 Ultra, S27 Pro, and S27+. Notably, the Ultra and Pro models feature a redesigned, nearly full-width camera island. Additionally, Xiaomi's 18s devices have also been introduced. This week marks the launch of GSMArena's first-ever yearly awards nominees, highlighting significant developments in the smartphone industry.

technology.title: iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e: Expected price, specifications, launch timeline and more
technology.summary: Apple is expected to launch the standard iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 in India next year, likely in spring. The new models may feature a faster A20 chip, larger batteries, and camera upgrades. While the iPhone 18 Pro series and foldable iPhones were unveiled in September, the standard models were not included in the launch event.

technology.title: American Woman Gets Lost AirPods Back At Delhi Airport In 4 Days: ‘In The US, I Would’ve Never...'
technology.summary: An American woman lost her AirPods at Delhi Airport during her visit to India with her husband. After four days of uncertainty, she received her AirPods back from the airport staff, expressing gratitude for their efforts. She remarked that in the United States, she likely would not have had the same experience in recovering lost items.

sports.title: Banton, Atkinson star as England hit back to force series decider
sports.summary: England bounced back from a defeat in Perth, winning the second ODI against Australia in Adelaide by 135 runs. Opener Banton scored 121 runs, leading a strong batting performance. Atkinson's bowling was pivotal, taking key wickets and dismantling Australia's top order within seven overs. This victory levels the series, setting up a decisive third match.

sports.title: Banton, Atkinson star as England hit back to force series decider
sports.summary: England leveled the ODI series against Australia by winning the second match in Adelaide by 135 runs. Opener Banton scored 121 runs, leading a strong batting performance. In response to Australia's target of 355, England's bowlers, led by Atkinson, quickly dismantled the Australian top order, taking crucial wickets within the first seven overs to secure the victory.

health.title: WHO Releases First Guidelines On Type 1 Diabetes In Adults: What To Know
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has released its first guidelines for managing type 1 diabetes in adults. The guidelines aim to improve treatment access and healthcare services for millions affected by the condition. WHO estimates that over 40% of individuals with diabetes are undiagnosed, highlighting the need for increased awareness and better healthcare solutions for this population.

health.title: Stopping GLP-1 Weight-Loss Drugs? Study Flags Nearly Double Risk Of Heart Attack, Stroke And Death
health.summary: A recent study indicates that stopping GLP-1 weight-loss drugs significantly increases the risk of heart attack, stroke, and death in individuals with type 2 diabetes, nearly doubling these risks. GLP-1 medications have been effective in managing blood sugar levels and aiding weight loss, highlighting the importance of continued use for those benefiting from these treatments.

health.title: Advanced Liver Disease Declines
health.summary: Advanced chronic liver disease among people who inject drugs in Australia decreased from 2018 to 2025. Researchers linked this decline to improved access to hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatments and higher rates of treatment uptake. The findings suggest that enhanced healthcare initiatives may contribute to better health outcomes for this population, highlighting the importance of accessible medical interventions.

science.title: SpaceX’s Starship returns from orbit and is captured by launch pad arms in a dramatic first
science.summary: SpaceX’s Starship successfully returned to Earth on November 14, 2026, after a 22-hour mission, being captured midair by mechanical arms at the launch pad. This event marks a significant milestone in SpaceX's efforts toward reusability and supports its broader goals of future missions to the Moon and Mars. The achievement reflects advancements in space technology and engineering.

science.title: Strange new material pulses in perfect rhythm to make future robots feel more alive
science.summary: Physicists have developed a new material composed of motorized cells that vibrate randomly but merge into a synchronized pulse, creating a mechanical time crystal. This innovation allows the material to maintain a unified rhythm, contrasting with traditional orchestras that struggle without a conductor. The advancement could enhance the design of future robots, making them feel more lifelike.

science.title: A dead star is flashing radio waves every 8 minutes, and its partner looks a lot like the sun
science.summary: Astronomers have identified a new type of cosmic object known as long-period radio transients, which emit bright radio wave flashes every few minutes to hours. Since 2022, these transients have been linked to binary systems featuring a red dwarf star and a white dwarf stellar remnant. The discovery enhances understanding of these unique astronomical phenomena and their characteristics.

entertainment.title: After Years Of Being Bedridden, Actor Sharad Kapoor Urges Film Industry To Support Him
entertainment.summary: Actor Sharad Kapoor has appealed to the film industry for support after being bedridden for years. In an Instagram video, he expressed his struggles and requested work and financial assistance. Hema Choudhary, a friend and head of the Bezubaan Public Welfare Trust, provided an update on his health, emphasizing the challenges he has faced during this time.

entertainment.title: Kajal Aggarwal Reveals She And Gautam Kitchlu Broke Up, Dated Other People Before Marriage
entertainment.summary: Kajal Aggarwal discussed her relationship with Gautam Kitchlu, revealing they broke up before eventually reuniting and marrying. She recounted their first meeting at a friend's wedding through mutual friends. Currently enjoying success from her role as Mandodari in Ramayana, Kajal reflected on their journey together, including dating other people prior to their marriage.

entertainment.title: Actor Nandish Sandhu Marries Kavita Banerjee In Traditional Bengali Wedding, See Pics
entertainment.summary: Actor Nandish Singh Sandhu married Kavita Banerjee in a traditional Bengali ceremony in Kolkata on November 14. The wedding followed their roka ceremony in September 2025 and was attended by family and friends. This event marks a significant milestone in their personal lives, celebrating their union over a two-day celebration filled with cultural traditions and festivities.
